instagram.caption:
The single sock box.
The Folding Surface in the Laundry Room. Turn a finished dry load into clothes that are back in drawers the same day.

What done looks like:
1. A counter bare enough to roll pastry on
2. One empty basket per bedroom stacked underneath it
3. Six spare hangers on the rail at the end
4. No clean clothing anywhere in the room
